analogy.rationale: Histone demethylase inhibitors block KDM enzymes (KDM3A/KDM4C/KDM6B) and EGLN1, altering chromatin methylation and HIF hydroxylation, so other epigenetic modifiers (histone lysine methyltransferase and HDAC inhibitors) and DNA methyltransferase inhibitors should give the most similar transcriptional responses; HSP inhibitors share proteotoxic/chromatin stress programs to a lesser degree.
